headline: Clinton order creates a presidential commission to study economic options for tobacco-dependent communities while protecting public health.
what_it_does: This executive order sets up a President's Commission focused on communities whose economies depend on growing tobacco. Based on its title, the commission is meant to look at ways to improve economic opportunity in those communities while also protecting public health. No summary was provided, so details such as membership, duties, and deadlines are not described here.

who_it_affects.how: The commission is meant to study and suggest ways to improve their economic opportunities.

when_it_takes_effect: 2000-09-22 (date signed; exact effective date not stated in the source)
